messages:
emily: Need a microcopy pass for the tri-mode landing. Aim: single hero with subtle personalization (query param or header) + three visible CTAs. Drafts by Wed.

rafa: Thinking in-moment copy: small headline, supportive subhead, then three compact cards for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Keep each card same length.

mike: UX constraint: primary CTA must stay above the fold. Secondary CTAs can be smaller links. Also add an inline benchmark pill near the hero: two metrics max.

emily: Microcopy experiments (short):
- Hosted hero line: "Start serving in minutes — fast API, clear quotas."
- Dedicated hero line: "Committed throughput for mission-critical ML."
- Private hero line: "Inference inside your network — keys and audit logs."
CTA labels (short): "Try hosted", "Reserve capacity", "Request private trial"

rafa: For the benchmark pill: "p99: ~140ms (chat) • 40-60% lower per-token cost vs default OSS stack" and a tooltip: "Test method: 1k concurrent chat sessions, 1k-token context, NVidia-A-series. See methodology."

mike: Legal-bot flag: avoid absolute dollar claims. Percent ranges and comparative language OK. Also avoid implying certified compliance; use "supports common compliance controls" not "HIPAA compliant" unless vetted.

legal-bot: Acknowledge: will review any security claim. Send any customer quotes for approval before publishing.

emily: Inbound form idea: single dropdown "Im evaluating for" with options: Prototype, Production, Enterprise. Add checkbox "compliance required" and company size field.

mike: Routing matrix suggestion (simple):
- Prototype -> self-serve nurture
- Production & size <= 250 -> SDR follow-up
- Production & size > 250 OR compliance checked -> AE/Enterprise
Also set event names for analytics: page.hero_variant, cta.click, benchmark.tooltip_open.

rafa: Webinar slot to promote on page: 30-40m "Choosing the right inference deployment" with a live benchmark demo + panel. Promo copy: "See live benchmarks and real configs from customers."

calendar-bot: Proposed webinar times: Tue May 6 10:00AM PT, Thu May 8 1:00PM PT, Mon May 12 11:00AM PT. Link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/serve-deploy-webinar

emily: Copy deck structure I'll assemble: hero microcopy + three card bodies (20-30 words each) + benchmark pill content + form mapping + webinar promo snippet + analytics naming.

mike: Quick copy for the three cards, 25 words each max:
- Hosted: "Fast REST API, predictable quotas, free trial credits. Ideal for experimentation and light production traffic. Scale up without infra ops."
- Dedicated: "Reserved GPU pools and autoscaling policies for steady throughput. Predictable latency and unit costs for production apps."
- Private: "Private control plane, VPC or on-prem options, key management integrations and audit logs for regulated workloads."

rafa: A/B test plan: Variant 1 primary CTA = product action (Try hosted / Reserve capacity / Request private trial). Variant 2 primary CTA = Learn (See benchmarks). Measure MQL conversion and time to activation.

emily: Can someone collect short (10-15 word) customer lines for each mode? Prefer concrete outcomes like "Cut inference latency by 3x" but legal must approve.

legal-bot: Will review before publish. Provide speaker deck for webinar and any benchmark details to compliance.

mike: Design ask: show hero personalization as small toggle "Mode: Hosted / Dedicated / Private" and use cookie/query param to persist. Also show benchmark pill and webinar CTA inline.

rafa: I'll wire up modular copy blocks in Figma after I get the deck.

emily: Great. Deliverables: copy deck + benchmark pill copy + inbound form mapping + webinar promo by Wed EOD. I'll run a quick review Thurs morning.

calendar-bot: Webinar slot tentatively set to Tue May 6 10:00AM PT (pending hosts).

emily: Thanks all — leaving a checklist in the copy deck and tagging owners. Drop approved quotes and sanitized numbers here when ready.
